about:
Nashville Metal Art & Fabrication operates from Lebanon, Tennessee. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The business presents itself as a maker of American-made metal art and outdoor products.

The company produces a line of patriotic metal art including solar-powered garden lights, decorative flags, and collapsible steel fire pits. Products are described as handcrafted in Tennessee and feature designs such as the Heritage Eagle solar light, Pledge of Allegiance flags, and the LIFTED BRO-CO collapsible fire pit. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

The brand sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce site, targeting patriotic home decor, outdoor living, and military tribute markets. A "Request a Quote" option suggests some custom work, though no B2B industries or OEM customers are identified.

Nashville Metal Art emphasizes domestic production, marketing its goods as "Handcrafted in Tennessee" and "100% Made in the USA." Solar lights ship with pre-installed batteries and require no wiring; fire pits collapse for portability. The stated lead time is four to six weeks.

name: Nashville Wire Products - Engineered Components
old_description: Nashville Wire Products develops and manufactures complex metal solutions that are found in millions of homes, retail stores, warehouses and restaurants throughout the country.
about:
Nashville Wire Products is headquartered in White Bluff, Tennessee, with additional manufacturing facilities in Tennessee, Kentucky, and Alabama. The company develops and manufactures complex metal solutions used in homes, retail stores, warehouses, and restaurants nationwide.

The company operates over one million square feet of production and warehouse space, producing millions of parts daily. Its in-house capabilities include CNC wire forming (up to 0.375-inch diameter), electro plating, laser cutting, powder coating, sheet metal fabrication, tube forming and fabrication, wire mesh welding, and warehousing and distribution. Engineering, prototyping, procurement, and vertical integration with raw material sources are all managed internally.

Nashville Wire Products serves the material handling, commercial refrigeration, commercial cooking, residential refrigeration, residential cooking, retail, and warehousing sectors. Its product divisions encompass wire decking, perforated deck, Kwik™ Shelf, pallet supports, containers, rolling carts, apparel shelving, pallet stops, engineered components, roller racks, standalone shelving, and cable trays.

The company emphasizes its “All In-House” model, citing automation for speed-to-market, U.S. locations that reduce transit times, and global sourcing partnerships in Asia and a company-owned facility in Mexico that provide blended pricing and flexible capacity.

name: Nassau Foods Inc
old_description: Nassau Foods is the one-stop supplier for butcher shops, meat processors, and food manufacturers.
about:
Founded in 1990 in Brooklyn Park, Minnesota, Nassau Foods began as a supplier focused on independent butcher shops and meat processors that larger distributors overlooked. The company was built to answer the phone, know the products, and treat a 10-case order with the same care as a pallet.

Today Nassau Foods operates as a one-stop source for seasoning mixes, bulk spices, marinades, cures, casings, netting, smoking supplies, dehydrated fruits and vegetables, vacuum bags, and sauces. Orders ship same or next day from its Brooklyn Park facility, and the product line has expanded to include a retail brand, Grandpa Josh’s, launched in the mid-1990s for home sausage makers and hunters.

The customer base spans independent butcher shops, meat processors, food manufacturers, and, through Grandpa Josh’s, home sausage makers, hunters, and game processors. Growth has been driven almost entirely by word-of-mouth referrals.

The company’s founding principle — serving the smaller operator with the same attention as large accounts — remains its stated differentiator, along with next-day shipping on most orders and a product range that covers the full spectrum of meat-processing needs.

name: National Breaker Services L.L.C.
old_description: INDUSTRY LEADER IN SWITCHGEAR & CIRCUIT BREAKER LIFE EXTENTION
about:
National Breaker Services L.L.C. operates from Middlebury, Connecticut. The company focuses on switchgear and circuit breaker life extension.

The company manufactures the Citadel® 2.0 vacuum breaker and custom walk-in switchgear rated up to 5,000 amps at 15 kV and 3,000 amps at 38 kV. It also produces transformer primary protection units (TPPU) to 38 kV with a compact footprint, free-standing switchgear, and dog houses. Services include retro-fill replacement, engineered fabrication, and turnkey installation with start-up and training.

National Breaker Services serves power engineers, utilities, and engineering-procurement-construction (EPC) firms.

The company emphasizes rugged, utility-grade construction under its American Rugged® and Switchgear Like it Used to Be® trademarks, promoting precise field measurement and fabrication to reduce installation cost and time.

name: National Power Equipment
old_description: Reinforced cell side secondary disconnect block with contacts.
about:
National Power Equipment, Inc. (NPE) operates from Cleveland, Ohio, where it was founded in 1994. The company began with a simple realization: industrial customers do not merely need equipment, they need a reliable source for solutions to fix and maintain large switchgear and circuit breakers. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed, and the founders are not named in available sources.

The company supplies used and remanufactured air and vacuum circuit breakers, substation switchgear, protective relays, and related parts. Its warehouses hold thousands of circuit breakers and switchgear cabinets along with tens of thousands of components. NPE specializes in low‑voltage (600 V AC or less) through medium‑voltage (15 kV) equipment, carrying product lines from every major U.S. manufacturer dating back to 1940. Beyond distribution, it manufactures a growing aftermarket parts list (AFT) that upgrades commonly failing components with modern materials, and it offers reconditioning services, rental and exchange programs, quick‑ship inventory, and technical manuals. The firm also provides 24/7 emergency support and assistance with both scheduled and unscheduled outages.

Customers span the full spectrum of the electrical industry, including industrial plants, utilities, and government agencies. NPE is an approved U.S. Government vendor (CAGE code 84AC4), indicating a track record with federal buyers.

The company differentiates itself by focusing on tailored, cost‑effective solutions rather than simple product sales. Its aftermarket parts are engineered to eliminate original design weaknesses, and real‑time inventory visibility lets buyers confirm availability instantly.

name: Natural Kinships Store
old_description: We are a local family working every step of the process from reclaiming Oregon trees, designing and building and retailing from our downtown Bend, Oregon store.
about:
Natural Kinships Store operates from a downtown storefront in Bend, Oregon. The company is family-owned, though a founding year is not publicly stated. The business began as a local family operation reclaiming Oregon trees and crafting furniture.

The company reclaims Oregon timber, designs and builds handcrafted furniture in-house, and retails directly from its Bend showroom. Its product line includes dining tables, coffee tables, desks, benches, conference tables, and specialty pieces such as fireplace mantels and headboards. It also fabricates custom metal bases and offers live-edge, straight-edge, and custom-built tables. The shop provides in-home and office design consultations to tailor pieces to specific spaces.

Natural Kinships serves residential and commercial clients, including homeowners and office managers seeking custom furniture. The consultation service targets both in-home and office environments, indicating a focus on interior design and space-specific solutions.

The company emphasizes controlling every step from tree reclamation to final retail, positioning its vertically integrated, family-run process as a differentiator. Custom fabrication and direct customer collaboration are cited as core to its approach.

name: Natural Northern Foods
old_description: Try our delicious creations, naturally made in Traverse City, Michigan
about:
Natural Northern Foods operates from Traverse City, Michigan, where Lori founded the company in 2005. The business is woman-owned and operated, beginning with a fresh salsa recipe inspired by local farmer’s markets and expanding into a line of hand-made, all-natural foods.

The company produces salsa, hummus dips, cream cheese spreads, spices, rubs, and specialty items. Everything is made by hand in small batches to maintain quality control, with no preservatives added, non-GMO ingredients when available, and all products gluten-free. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed, but production occurs entirely at the Traverse City location.

Products are sold through more than 100 retail outlets across Michigan, including grocery chains such as Spartan, Family Fare, Oleson’s, and Tom’s, as well as independent markets like Burritt’s Market, Maxbauer’s Market, Oryana Stores, Edson Farms, Anderson’s Market, Galagher’s Farm Market, and Hansen Foods. The company also ships directly to consumers when items are not available locally.

Natural Northern Foods was started from a passion for creating great-tasting, whole, healthy foods without preservatives. Its stated mission emphasizes highest-quality ingredients, hand-made original recipes, small-batch production, and a commitment to non-GMO and gluten-free standards.
